dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Manuscript, pen-and-ink, watercolors, and pencil. Depths shown by soundings. Shows Gulf Coast from Mississippi River Delta to Apalachee Bay, Florida. Mounted on cloth backing. Printed label describing the map mounted on verso. Scale ca. 1:1,330,000. LC Luso-Hispanic World, 826 LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 1605 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
